title: Correct a budget amount
prompt: In input.xlsx, change the planned Supplies amount in Budget!B3 to 180. Keep the totals as formulas and update their calculated results. Save the result as output.xlsx, leaving input.xlsx unchanged and preserving everything else.

title: Repair a total formula
prompt: In input.xlsx, the Actual total in Budget!C5 leaves out Travel. Replace it with =SUM(C2:C4) and update its calculated result. Save the result as output.xlsx, leaving input.xlsx unchanged and preserving everything else.

title: Rename a product across sheets
prompt: In input.xlsx, replace every occurrence of the case-sensitive product name Trail Mix with Forest Mix on both Catalog and Orders. Keep the rest of each cell intact. Save the result as output.xlsx, leaving input.xlsx unchanged and preserving everything else.

title: Format a header
prompt: In input.xlsx, make Sales!A1:C1 bold and give those three header cells a solid light blue fill, color #D9EAF7. Save the result as output.xlsx, leaving input.xlsx unchanged and preserving everything else.

title: Sort an inventory table
prompt: In input.xlsx, sort Inventory!A2:C5 by Stock in column C, smallest to largest. Move each complete row together and leave the header in row 1. Save the result as output.xlsx, leaving input.xlsx unchanged and preserving everything else.

title: Add a currency total row
prompt: In input.xlsx, add a total row on Sales at row 5: A5 should say Total, B5 should contain =SUM(B2:B4), and C5 should contain =SUM(C2:C4). Format B5:C5 as dollars with two decimal places and a thousands separator, using $#,##0.00, and save calculated results. Save the result as output.xlsx, leaving input.xlsx unchanged and preserving everything else.

title: Insert a growth column
prompt: In input.xlsx, insert a column immediately after Revenue column C, moving the existing Status column to E. Name D1 Growth %. In D2:D4 use =(C2-B2)/B2, =(C3-B3)/B3, and =(C4-B4)/B4 respectively. Format D2:D4 as percentages with one decimal place, using 0.0%, and save calculated results. Save the result as output.xlsx, leaving input.xlsx unchanged and preserving everything else.

title: Rename and reorder sheets
prompt: In input.xlsx, rename Forecast to Outlook. Arrange the tabs in this order: Actuals, Outlook, Assumptions. Keep the formulas on Assumptions working by changing its B2 reference to ='Outlook'!B2; keep all other formulas and values intact. Save the result as output.xlsx, leaving input.xlsx unchanged and preserving everything else.

title: Build a linked budget summary
prompt: In input.xlsx, add an Expenses total row at row 5 with A5 Total, B5 =SUM(B2:B4), and C5 =SUM(C2:C4). On Summary, set B2 to ='Expenses'!B5, B3 to ='Expenses'!C5, and B4 to =B3-B2. Format Expenses!B5:C5 and Summary!B2:B4 as dollars using $#,##0.00 and save calculated results. Save the result as output.xlsx, leaving input.xlsx unchanged and preserving everything else.

title: Prepare a quarterly report
prompt: In input.xlsx on Quarterly, insert Growth % in a new column D, moving Owner to E. Sort the three data rows by Q2 descending, keeping each owner with the product. Set D2:D4 to =(C2-B2)/B2, =(C3-B3)/B3, and =(C4-B4)/B4. Add row 5 with A5 Total, B5 =SUM(B2:B4), C5 =SUM(C2:C4), and D5 =(C5-B5)/B5. Use 0.0% in D2:D5 and $#,##0.00 in B5:C5. Make A1:E1 bold with solid #D9EAF7 fill. Save calculated results. Save the result as output.xlsx, leaving input.xlsx unchanged and preserving everything else.
